title: CODATA 2022: the electron mass is 9.109 383 7139 × 10⁻³¹ kg
summary: The standard uncertainty is 0.000 000 0028 × 10⁻³¹ kg. The mass-energy equivalent is 0.510 998 950 69 MeV.
body: The NIST 2022 listing prints 'electron mass 9.109 383 7139 e-31' with standard uncertainty '0.000 000 0028 e-31', in kilograms. The same listing prints 'electron mass energy equivalent in MeV 0.510 998 950 69' with standard uncertainty '0.000 000 000 16' MeV. It also prints 'electron mass in u 5.485 799 090 441 e-4' with standard uncertainty '0.000 000 000 097 e-4' u. The electron g factor on the same listing is '−2.002 319 304 360 92' with standard uncertainty '0.000 000 000 000 36'. These are measured quantities. They are not defining constants.
